component.name: Lekhani
component.summary: Modern Pure Rust Bengali Input Method & Desktop Suite

description.p: Lekhani is a modern, ultra-fast, Unicode-compliant Bengali input method for Linux. It features Avro Phonetic transliteration, popular fixed keyboard layouts (Probhat, National Jatiya, Munir Optima, Borno), a native Slint UI, Bijoy-to-Unicode conversion, emoji shortcodes, and an IBus DBus service.
